newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Elbit Systems in talks for Brazil deal.
newsitem.headline: Elbit Systems in talks for Brazil deal.

text.p: Israel's Elbit Systems Ltd is in advanced negotiations with the government of Brazil to provide a security and monitoring system worth $70 million, Israel's Haaretz newspaper said on Monday.
A spokesman for the company, a maker of defence electronics, was not immediately available to comment.
The newspaper said the equipment, which would be provided over several years, would be used on planes taking part in a security project being estabished by Brazil.
The project is being managed by an American company and is aimed at fighting the contraband and drug trade.
